## Classes

### <a name="bigcouch"></a>`bigcouch`

BigCouch is Cloudant's clustered CouchDB 1.1, whose features went into
CouchDB 2. Nothing publishes BigCouch packages for Debian 12 or 13;
[puppet-bigcouch-packaging](https://github.com/freepenguins/puppet-bigcouch-packaging) builds `bigcouch` 0.4.2b (with
Erlang/OTP R16B03-1) and the `couch-libmozjs185-1.0` it needs. Publish
them in an APT repository and give it as `repository`, or leave
`repository` unset to install `package_name` from whatever APT sources the
server already has.

Puppet writes `local.ini` and `vm.args` before installing the package,
because the package starts BigCouch, and a node renamed after its first
start keeps the old name in its shard maps. The admin password is written
already hashed in BigCouch's own format, so BigCouch leaves it alone.

#### Examples

##### One node on 127.0.0.1 with an admin

```puppet
class { 'bigcouch':
  admin_username => 'admin',
  admin_password => Sensitive('change-me'),
  repository     => {
    'location' => 'https://apt.example.com/bigcouch/',
    'release'  => $facts['os']['distro']['codename'],
    'repos'    => 'main',
    'key'      => {
      'name'   => 'bigcouch.asc',
      'source' => 'https://apt.example.com/bigcouch/key.asc',
    },
  },
}
```

##### Listening on every address, with more logging

```puppet
class { 'bigcouch':
  admin_username => 'admin',
  admin_password => Sensitive('change-me'),
  bind_address   => '0.0.0.0',
  settings       => {
    'log' => { 'level' => 'debug' },
  },
}
```

##### More Erlang VM arguments

```puppet
class { 'bigcouch':
  vm_args => ['+P 1048576', '-kernel net_ticktime 30'],
}
```

##### <a name="-bigcouch--admin_username"></a>`admin_username`

Data type: `Optional[Pattern[/\A[^\s=:]+\z/]]`

The admin to create. Without one BigCouch runs in "admin party" mode,
where anyone who reaches the port is an admin.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--admin_password"></a>`admin_password`

Data type: `Optional[Variant[String[1], Sensitive[String[1]]]]`

The admin's password.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--repository"></a>`repository`

Data type: `Optional[Hash[String[1], Any]]`

`apt::source` parameters for the repository with the `bigcouch` and
`couch-libmozjs185-1.0` packages, such as `location`, `release`, `repos`
and `key` (`{ name, source }`) or `allow_unsigned`. Unset, no source is
added and the package comes from the APT sources already configured.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--package_name"></a>`package_name`

Data type: `String[1]`

The BigCouch package.

Default value: `'bigcouch'`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--package_ensure"></a>`package_ensure`

Data type: `String[1]`

The package's `ensure`, such as a version.

Default value: `'installed'`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--bind_address"></a>`bind_address`

Data type: `Stdlib::IP::Address::Nosubnet`

Address both HTTP APIs listen on.

Default value: `'127.0.0.1'`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--port"></a>`port`

Data type: `Stdlib::Port`

The clustered HTTP API port.

Default value: `5984`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--node_local_port"></a>`node_local_port`

Data type: `Stdlib::Port`

The node-local HTTP API port.

Default value: `5986`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--node_name"></a>`node_name`

Data type: `Pattern[/\A[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\z/]`

Erlang node name. Defaults to `bigcouch@<fqdn>`, what the package's own
`-name bigcouch` becomes. Set it before the first run (see above).

Default value: `"bigcouch@${facts['networking']['fqdn']}"`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--cookie"></a>`cookie`

Data type: `Variant[Pattern[/\A[A-Za-z0-9]+\z/], Sensitive[Pattern[/\A[A-Za-z0-9]+\z/]]]`

Erlang distribution cookie. Nodes of one cluster must share it. Defaults
to a random string that stays the same for this node.

Default value: `Sensitive(stdlib::fqdn_rand_string(32, undef, 'bigcouch cookie'))`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--config_dir"></a>`config_dir`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Where `local.ini`, `runtime.ini` and `vm.args` go. The package's
`/opt/bigcouch/bin/bigcouch` reads `/etc/bigcouch/vm.args`.

Default value: `'/etc/bigcouch'`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--data_dir"></a>`data_dir`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Databases and view indexes.

Default value: `'/var/lib/bigcouch'`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--log_file"></a>`log_file`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

BigCouch's log.

Default value: `'/var/log/bigcouch/bigcouch.log'`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--user"></a>`user`

Data type: `String[1]`

The user BigCouch runs as, which owns `data_dir`.

Default value: `'bigcouch'`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--group"></a>`group`

Data type: `String[1]`

The group of `user`.

Default value: `'bigcouch'`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--service_name"></a>`service_name`

Data type: `String[1]`

The service the package installs.

Default value: `'bigcouch'`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--settings"></a>`settings`

Data type: `Hash[String[1], Hash[String[1], Scalar]]`

More settings for `local.ini`, as `{ section => { key => value } }`,
merged over the module's (yours win).

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-bigcouch--vm_args"></a>`vm_args`

Data type: `Array[Pattern[/\A[^\r\n]+\z/]]`

More lines for `vm.args`, written as given after the module's own, such
as `'+P 1048576'` or `'-kernel net_ticktime 30'`. For an emulator flag
the module already sets (`+A`, `+K`), the later line wins. Don't set
`-name`, `-setcookie` or `-couch_ini` here: use `node_name`, `cookie`
and `settings`.

Default value: `[]`

## Functions

### <a name="bigcouch--admin_hash"></a>`bigcouch::admin_hash`

Type: Ruby 4.x API

BigCouch (like CouchDB 1.x) replaces a plain-text admin password with a
hash when it starts and writes the hash back to its configuration, so a
plain-text password in a Puppet-managed file would change on every run. A
hash in BigCouch's own format, `-hashed-<sha1(password + salt)>,<salt>`, is
left alone. The salt should stay the same for a node (for example from
`stdlib::fqdn_rand_string`), so the result is the same on every run.

#### Examples

##### 

```puppet
bigcouch::admin_hash(Sensitive('secret'), 'a1b2c3d4')
```

#### `bigcouch::admin_hash(Variant[String[1], Sensitive[String[1]]] $password, Pattern[/\A[A-Za-z0-9]+\z/] $salt)`

BigCouch (like CouchDB 1.x) replaces a plain-text admin password with a
hash when it starts and writes the hash back to its configuration, so a
plain-text password in a Puppet-managed file would change on every run. A
hash in BigCouch's own format, `-hashed-<sha1(password + salt)>,<salt>`, is
left alone. The salt should stay the same for a node (for example from
`stdlib::fqdn_rand_string`), so the result is the same on every run.

Returns: `Sensitive[String]` The value for the admin's line in `[admins]`.

##### Examples

###### 

```puppet
bigcouch::admin_hash(Sensitive('secret'), 'a1b2c3d4')
```

##### `password`

Data type: `Variant[String[1], Sensitive[String[1]]]`

The admin password.

##### `salt`

Data type: `Pattern[/\A[A-Za-z0-9]+\z/]`

The salt, as a string of letters and digits.
